branches.en: A reputation without blame carries the mark-of-shame idea into character.
branches.cn: 清白的名声把「耻辱印记」的观念带到了人的品格上。

branches.en: Steel and a well-wiped cloth both refuse to keep a dirty mark.
branches.cn: 不锈钢和擦净的布料都留不住脏痕。

branches.en: In both cases the value lies in nothing being left behind.
branches.cn: 两者的价值都在于什么都留不下痕迹。

intro.en: Stainless is made of the English noun stain and the privative suffix -less, which says that the stain is not there.
intro.cn: stainless 由英语名词 stain 与表否定的词尾 -less 组成，-less 说明污渍并不存在。

latinIntro.en: Neither part is Latin: stain comes through Old French, and -less is a native English suffix from Old English leas.
latinIntro.cn: 两部分都不是拉丁语来源：stain 经古法语传入，-less 是来自古英语 leas 的本土词尾。

items.example: Stain is the base that -less takes away.
items.exampleCN: stain 是被 -less 否定的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -less turns stain into stainless.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -less 把 stain 变成 stainless。

items.example: Leas is the older form behind the suffix -less.
items.exampleCN: leas 是词尾 -less 更古老的形式。

items.example: Stained is the positive partner of stainless.
items.exampleCN: stained 是 stainless 的肯定形式的对照词。

items.example: Stainless steel is the fixed phrase of modern industry.
items.exampleCN: stainless steel 是现代工业的固定说法。

items.example: Stainlessly shows an adverb suffix on top of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: stainlessly 展示了在形容词上加副词词尾。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms stainlessly.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 stainlessly。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms stainlessness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 构成 stainlessness。

items.example: Spotless is built with the same negative suffix.
items.exampleCN: spotless 用同一个否定词尾构成。

definition_zh: 楼梯；楼梯间；螺旋状长楼梯；阶梯式排列
definition_en: a set of stairs and its supporting structure, usually inside a building
core_image: 一段一段向上转的楼梯：每一处楼梯平台都把人抬高一层
scene: 老楼翻修时，工人把积满灰的木楼梯打磨得发亮。During the renovation, the workers polished the dusty wooden staircase until it shone.
sceneCN: 这里 staircase 是「楼梯」（第 1 个义项：供人上下楼的整段阶梯结构）；句意：老楼翻修时，工人把积满灰的木楼梯打磨得发亮。

pos.zh: 楼梯；楼梯间；螺旋楼梯；阶梯状排列

derivatives.zh: 由基础词去掉构成成分 -case 得到的单位名词，义为「一级台阶；楼梯」
基础词族 + -well（竖井），义为「楼梯井；楼梯间竖井」
同族近义词 + -way（通道），义为「楼梯通道」
同族词 + up（向上）+ -s（副词尾），义为「在楼上；向楼上」

senses.title: A set of stairs in a building
senses.definition: the complete structure of steps that lets people move between floors inside a building
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物内部供人在楼层之间上下的完整阶梯结构
senses.example: She carried the box up the narrow staircase.
senses.exampleCN: 她沿着狭窄的楼梯把箱子搬上楼。
senses.why: The core image is a run of steps that keeps turning to raise a person from one floor to the next.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一段不断转折上升的阶梯，把人从一层送到另一层，所以最常指楼内供上下楼的整段楼梯。

senses.title: A spiral or grand stair
senses.titleCN: 螺旋楼梯；气派的大台阶
senses.definition: a large or spiralling stair built as a feature, as in an entrance hall or a castle tower
senses.definitionCN: 作为建筑特色修建的大型或盘旋式楼梯，如门厅或塔楼里的楼梯
senses.example: A spiral staircase led up to the tower room.
senses.exampleCN: 一道螺旋楼梯通向塔顶的房间。
senses.why: When the turn of the steps is wound around a central post, the same staircase becomes a spiral one.
senses.whyCN: 当阶梯绕着中心柱一圈圈盘绕上升时，同一座楼梯就呈现为螺旋楼梯，因此义项从「阶梯结构」细化到「盘旋或气派的造型」。

senses.title: A stair-like arrangement
senses.titleCN: 阶梯式排列；层层上升的东西
senses.definition: anything arranged in successive levels like steps, such as a cliff face or a pattern of light
senses.definitionCN: 像台阶一样逐层递增排列的事物，如层叠的崖壁、逐级上升的光线或图案
senses.example: The cliff formed a natural staircase of flat ledges.
senses.exampleCN: 那片岩壁形成了一道天然的平台阶梯。
senses.why: Because the chain of steps is a shape as well as a structure, the word is borrowed for anything laid out in rising levels.
senses.whyCN: 阶梯既是一种结构也是一种形状，所以凡逐级升高、一层层排列的事物都可以用这个词来比喻。

intro.en: Staircase joins the old noun stair, one step on a flight, to case, an enclosing structure, and names the whole flight at once.
intro.cn: staircase 由古老的 stair（一级台阶）与 case（容纳东西的外壳、框）组合而成，指整段楼梯。

items.en: Staer names a single step and is also the ancestor of stair itself.
items.cn: 古英语 staer 指一级台阶，正是 stair 的前身。

items.en: Stair spreads as a name for one step and moves toward a flight of steps.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 stair 既指一阶，也开始指一整段阶梯。

items.en: Staircase appears, formed from stair plus case, the enclosing structure of a flight.
items.cn: staircase 在十七世纪出现，由 stair 加上表示外壳结构的 case 构成。

items.en: Staircase and stairway are used for grand flights in halls and towers.
items.cn: 十九世纪，staircase 与 stairway 常用来指门厅和塔楼里的气派楼梯。

items.en: The word now also names any stair-like arrangement, from cliff ledges to light.
items.cn: 现代英语中它还可指任何阶梯状排列，从岩壁平台到光线都可用。

note.en: Staircase is a compound, so its look-alikes are the members of its family, while its near meanings are ordinary words for steps.
note.cn: staircase 是复合词，形近项来自它自己的词族，近义项则是表示台阶的普通词。

entries.definition: one step, or a flight of steps, or stairs as a set
entries.definitionCN: 一级台阶；一段台阶；楼梯（常用复数）

entries.definition: the vertical shaft that contains a staircase
entries.definitionCN: 容纳楼梯的竖向井道

entries.definition: a flight of stairs or the way formed by it
entries.definitionCN: 一段楼梯；楼梯通道

entries.definition: on or to a higher floor of a building
entries.definitionCN: 在楼上；向楼上

entries.definition: the steps that lead from one floor to another
entries.definitionCN: 楼层之间的楼梯（日常说法）

entries.definition: a short set of outside steps
entries.definitionCN: 屋外的一小段台阶

entries.definition: a portable set of bars used for climbing
entries.definitionCN: 可搬动的梯子

normalIntro.en: Staircase is stair plus case: a case is the shell that holds something, so a staircase is the whole case built around all those steps.
normalIntro.cn: staircase 就是 stair 加 case：case 是容纳东西的外壳，所以 staircase 就是包住所有台阶的整个「壳」。

normal.en: Stair means one step, and case means an enclosing structure.
normal.cn: stair 是一级台阶，case 是包裹的结构。

normal.en: A spiral staircase winds around a central post.
normal.cn: 螺旋楼梯绕着中心柱盘旋而上。

normal.en: A stairwell is the shaft that holds a staircase.
normal.cn: stairwell 是容纳楼梯的竖井。

normal.en: We say go up the staircase, not go on the staircase, for climbing.
normal.cn: 表示上楼用「go up the staircase」，不用 on。

normal.en: Compare stairs: stairs is what we walk on, staircase is the whole built structure.
normal.cn: 对比 stairs：stairs 是我们踩的台阶，staircase 是整座建造出来的结构。

abstract.en: Picture a dark wooden turnstile of steps spiralling up past a landing window.
abstract.cn: 想象深色木头台阶绕着楼梯平台的窗户盘旋而上。

abstract.en: Feel a polished handrail sliding under your palm as you climb.
abstract.cn: 感受上楼时磨亮的扶手从掌心下滑过。

abstract.en: See a cliff split into flat layers, as if a giant built it as steps.
abstract.cn: 想象一片岩壁被切成平整的几层，像巨人砌成的台阶。

examples.en: The old hotel has a marble staircase in its lobby.
examples.cn: 那家老酒店的门厅里有一道大理石楼梯。

examples.en: We climbed the staircase slowly because our suitcases were heavy.
examples.cn: 行李箱很重，我们慢慢爬上了楼梯。

examples.en: The terraced fields looked like a green staircase on the hillside.
examples.cn: 层层梯田像山坡上一道绿色的阶梯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「四代阶梯」——一家四代站在同一道楼梯上合影，一阶一阶往上排；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 staer（一级台阶）→ stair（台阶；楼梯）→ 十七世纪用 case（外壳、容纳结构）复合出 staircase，核心义「包住整段台阶的结构」。

sensesIntro.en: From one set of stairs inside a building, staircase widens to a grand or spiral flight, and then to any arrangement of rising levels.
sensesIntro.cn: staircase 从楼内供上下楼的一整段楼梯，扩展到宏伟或盘旋的楼梯，再到任何层层升高的排列。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chain of steps turning upward, one landing above the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一段段阶梯转折上升，每处平台都高出一层。

branches.en: The everyday sense is the full set of steps inside a building.
branches.cn: 日常义项是楼内供上下楼的整段台阶。

branches.en: A spiral staircase is the same structure wound around a post.
branches.cn: 螺旋楼梯是同一种结构绕着中心柱盘旋起来的样子。

branches.en: The stair shape is borrowed for ledges, light, and other rising levels.
branches.cn: 台阶的形状被借去形容岩层、光线等层层升高的东西。

branches.en: Both the ordinary staircase and the grand one carry people between floors.
branches.cn: 普通楼梯与气派楼梯的功能相同，都是在楼层之间运送人。

branches.en: Both senses rest on one repeated shape: a level, then a rise, then another level.
branches.cn: 两个义项都源于同一个重复图形：平面、升高、再一个平面。

intro.en: Staircase is a compound of the native noun stair and the word case, so its pieces are mostly whole English words rather than classical affixes.
intro.cn: staircase 是本土名词 stair 与 case 复合而成的词，组成部分多是完整的英语单词，而非古典词缀。

latinIntro.en: Classical Latin plays no part here; the members are native English and a French borrowing for the noun staircase itself.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有古典拉丁语成分：组成部分是本土英语词，而作为整体名词的 staircase 受法语词影响而出现。

items.example: Stair is the first half of the word.
items.exampleCN: stair 是这个词的前半部分。

items.example: Staer is the Old English ancestor of stair.
items.exampleCN: staer 是 stair 的古英语祖形。

items.example: Case adds the idea of a built shell.
items.exampleCN: case 带入了「建造出来的壳」这层意思。

items.example: Staircase names the whole flight.
items.exampleCN: staircase 指整段楼梯。

items.example: The suffix -way adds the sense of a passage.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -way 加入「通道」的意思。

items.example: The suffix -well adds the sense of a shaft.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -well 加入「竖井」的意思。

items.example: The suffix -way forms stairway and roadway.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -way 构成 stairway、roadway 等词。

items.example: The suffix -well forms stairwell and inkwell.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -well 构成 stairwell、inkwell 等词。

items.example: The prefix up- forms upstairs.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 up- 构成 upstairs。

definition_zh: 茎；秆；叶柄；跟踪；悄悄跟随；潜行
definition_en: the main stem of a plant, or to follow a person or animal quietly and closely
core_image: 一根挺直的植物茎秆，像竖起的杆子一样撑起叶片
scene: 稻草人站在田里，黄鼠狼却悄悄跟在野兔身后。In the cornfield a weasel began to stalk the rabbit through the tall plants.
sceneCN: 这里 stalk 是「悄悄跟踪」（第 2 个义项：偷偷地、耐心地跟在人或动物后面）；句意：在玉米地里，一只黄鼠狼开始穿过高高的庄稼悄悄跟踪野兔。

pos.zh: 跟踪；悄悄跟随；潜行猎捕

derivatives.zh: stalk 加 -er（做某事的人），义为「跟踪者；潜行猎手」
stalk 加 -ing 构成动名词，义为「跟踪骚扰；潜行猎捕」
stalk 加 -ed 构成形容词，义为「有茎的；有柄的」
stalk 加 -less（没有），义为「无茎的；无柄的」

senses.title: The main stem of a plant
senses.definition: the long main stem that carries the leaves or flowers of a plant
senses.definitionCN: 植物上支撑叶片或花朵的长而直的主茎
senses.example: The wheat stalks bent low in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 麦秆在风中低低弯下。
senses.why: The core image is an upright wooden rod, and the stem of a plant is exactly that, so the plant part is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一根竖立的木杆，而植物的茎正是这样一根挺直的柱子，所以「茎」是最早、最基本的义项。

senses.title: To follow and hunt quietly
senses.definition: to follow an animal or person quietly and patiently, as a hunter or a predator does
senses.definitionCN: 像猎人捕食者那样安静而耐心地跟在动物或人后面
senses.example: The tiger stalked a deer through the bamboo.
senses.exampleCN: 老虎穿过竹林悄悄跟踪一只鹿。
senses.why: Hunting grew from creeping along the tall stalks of grass, so the verb keeps the image of moving between upright stems unseen.
senses.whyCN: 狩猎时人要藏在高高的草丛茎秆间慢慢挪动，于是动词义保留了「在竖立的秆子间不露形迹地移动」这一画面。

senses.title: To walk with stiff purpose
senses.titleCN: 昂首阔步地走；气冲冲地走出
senses.definition: to move in a stiff, proud, or angry way, especially out of a place
senses.definitionCN: 以僵硬、傲慢或愤怒的姿态走动，尤指气冲冲地走出某处
senses.example: She stalked out of the meeting without a word.
senses.exampleCN: 她一言不发地气冲冲离开了会议室。
senses.why: The stiff stem became a way of walking: a person who stalks is as rigid and upright as a stalk standing in a field.
senses.whyCN: 僵直的茎秆转成了走路姿态：昂首阔步的人就像田里直挺挺立着的茎秆一样僵硬而挺拔。

intro.en: The noun stalk, a stem, goes back to a Germanic word for a pole or a stem, while the hunting verb is recorded somewhat later.
intro.cn: 名词 stalk（茎）可上溯到日耳曼语中表示杆子或茎的词，而表示狩猎的动词出现得稍晚一些。

items.en: Stela and stalu name a stalk or a stem of a plant.
items.cn: 古英语 stela、stalu 指植物的茎或秆。

items.en: Stalk is the usual spelling and means the stem of a plant.
items.cn: 中古英语中 stalk 成为通行拼法，指植物的茎。

items.en: The verb stalk is recorded with the sense to go stealthily, as a hunter does.
items.cn: 动词 stalk 在十四世纪有记录，意思是对像猎人那样悄悄前行。

items.en: A second stalk, meaning to walk proudly or stiffly, appears and later merges with the first.
items.cn: 十六世纪又出现一个 stalk，意为骄傲或僵硬地行走，后来与前一个词合流。

items.en: Stalk covers plant stems, hunting, and the modern crime of following a person.
items.cn: 现代英语中 stalk 兼指植物茎秆、狩猎跟踪以及当今的骚扰性跟踪行为。

note.en: Stalk has a plant side and a hunting side, so its look-alikes come from its family and its near meanings come from stems and from pursuit words.
note.cn: stalk 既有植物的一面，也有狩猎的一面：形近项来自同一词族，近义项则来自茎秆词与追逐词。

entries.definition: a person who follows someone secretly and repeatedly
entries.definitionCN: 反复秘密跟踪他人的人

entries.definition: the act of following a person or hunting game quietly
entries.definitionCN: 跟踪骚扰；潜行狩猎

entries.definition: having a stem, as a leaf or a fruit
entries.definitionCN: 有茎的；有柄的

entries.definition: having no stem
entries.definitionCN: 无茎的；无柄的

entries.definition: the main support of a plant, from which leaves grow
entries.definitionCN: 茎；主干

entries.definition: a long thin handle, stem, or bar
entries.definitionCN: 杆；柄；细长的柱体

entries.definition: to follow someone in order to catch them
entries.definitionCN: 追赶；追捕

entries.definition: to follow behind and keep track of someone
entries.definitionCN: 尾随；跟踪

normalIntro.en: Stalk is one upright rod: a plant stems it, a hunter follows it, and an angry person walks as stiff as it.
normalIntro.cn: stalk 是一根竖着的杆子：植物拿它当茎，猎人躲在它后面跟人，生气的人走路像它一样僵直。

normal.en: A stalk is the stem that holds up a leaf or a flower.
normal.cn: stalk 是托住叶片或花朵的茎。

normal.en: Stalker and stalking add -er and -ing to the hunting stalk.
normal.cn: stalker 与 stalking 是狩猎义的 stalk 加 -er、-ing 而来。

normal.en: Stalked and stalkless are formed with -ed and -less.
normal.cn: stalked 与 stalkless 分别由 -ed、-less 构成。

normal.en: The pattern stalk prey uses the hunting sense.
normal.cn: 搭配 stalk prey 用的是狩猎义。

normal.en: Compare stem: stem is the general botanical word, stalk is often used for grass, corn, and flowers.
normal.cn: 对比 stem：stem 是通用的植物学词，stalk 多用于草、玉米和花。

abstract.en: Picture a single thin stem of wheat swaying against an empty sky.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细麦秆在空旷的天空前摇摆。

abstract.en: See the outline of a fox low in the grass, moving without a sound.
abstract.cn: 想象草丛里一只狐狸压低身体，悄无声息地移动。

abstract.en: Hear a door slam as someone walks out stiff and straight.
abstract.cn: 想象门被砰地关上，一个人挺直僵硬的步子走出去。

examples.en: The bees gathered on a sunflower stalk.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂聚在一根向日葵的茎上。

examples.en: Reporters stalked the actor outside his flat.
examples.cn: 记者们在演员的公寓外跟踪他。

examples.en: He stalked off in anger when he heard the news.
examples.cn: 听到消息后，他气愤地大步离开了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「四道客」——四位客人蹲在草丛后偷偷跟踪猎物；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 stela / stalu（茎、秆）→ 中古英语 stalk（植物的茎）→ 名词义「茎」与动词义「潜行跟踪、昂首阔步地走」，核心义「挺直的杆状物」。

sensesIntro.en: Stalk begins with the stem of a plant, then turns into hunting quietly through tall stems, and finally into walking as stiff and proud as a stem.
sensesIntro.cn: stalk 从植物的茎开始，转为在高的茎秆间悄悄狩猎，最后变成像茎一样僵硬、傲慢地走路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one straight rod standing upright out of the ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根笔直竖出地面的杆子。

branches.en: The plant stem is the oldest and most literal branch.
branches.cn: 植物的茎是最古老也最字面的分支。

branches.en: Hunting quietly grew out of creeping through tall stems.
branches.cn: 悄悄狩猎义源于在高高茎秆间潜行的画面。

branches.en: The stiff, proud walk borrows the stiffness of the standing stem.
branches.cn: 昂首阔步义借用了茎秆挺立的僵硬感。

branches.en: A hunter stalks deer in exactly the kind of tall grass stalks that give the plant sense.
branches.cn: 猎人跟踪鹿的地方，正是给植物义提供意象的高草丛。

branches.en: Both verbs share the sense of moving on purpose in a controlled, tight line.
branches.cn: 两个动词义都表示有目的地沿一条克制而笔直的路线移动。

intro.en: Stalk is a Germanic noun and a matching verb, with modern English building a family on it through -er, -ing, -ed, and -less.
intro.cn: stalk 是日耳曼来源的名词兼动词，现代英语通过 -er、-ing、-ed、-less 在其上构成一个词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies no true source here; only early Germanic forms such as stela stand behind the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语并不是这个词的真正来源，背后只有 stela 这样的早期日耳曼语形式。

items.example: Stalk is the base noun.
items.exampleCN: stalk 是基础名词。

items.example: Stela is the Old English ancestor.
items.exampleCN: stela 是古英语祖形。

items.example: The verb stalk is a homograph of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 动词 stalk 与名词同形。

items.example: The suffix -er marks the person who stalks.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 标示出跟踪的那个人。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms the gerund stalking.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成动名词 stalking。

items.example: The same -ing form also works as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 同一个 -ing 形式也可作形容词。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms the adjective stalked.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成形容词 stalked。

items.example: The suffix -less forms stalkless.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -less 构成 stalkless。

items.example: Stalkless describes leaves that grow straight from the base.
items.exampleCN: stalkless 形容叶子直接从基部长出。

latinEntries.meaning: a log, a stock, a stem
a stalk or stem of a plant

definition_zh: 雄蕊；花丝；纺织中的经线
definition_en: the male part of a flower that produces pollen and is made of a filament topped by an anther
core_image: 细长的花丝托着顶端装满花粉的小囊，从花瓣中间伸出来
scene: 植物课上的老师掰开一朵百合花，让学生数一数里面细长的丝状结构。The teacher opened a lily and asked the class to count its golden stamens.
sceneCN: 这里 stamen 是「雄蕊」（第 1 个义项：花中产生花粉的雄性器官）；句意：老师掰开一朵百合花，让全班数一数它金黄色的雄蕊。

pos.zh: 雄蕊；花丝（雄蕊的丝状部分）

derivatives.zh: stamen 加 -al（属于……的），义为「雄蕊的；与雄蕊有关的」
stamen 的词干加 -ate，义为「有雄蕊的；雄花中只长雄蕊的」
stamen 加 -less（没有），义为「无雄蕊的」

senses.title: The male organ of a flower
senses.definition: the part of a flower that makes pollen, made of a slender filament with a sac-like anther on top
senses.definitionCN: 花中产生花粉的雄性器官，由细长的花丝和顶端囊状的花药组成
senses.example: The bee brushed against the stamens and flew off dusted with pollen.
senses.exampleCN: 蜜蜂蹭过雄蕊，沾着花粉飞走了。
senses.why: A stamen is literally a thread: the thin upright filament with its loaded anther is the core image of this sense.
senses.whyCN: stamen 本义就是一根线，细长直立的花丝托起装满花粉的花药，正是这个义项的核心意象。

senses.title: The filament alone
senses.definition: in older botanical use, the thin stalk of the stamen on its own, without the anther
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的植物学用法中，单指雄蕊中细长的花丝，不包括花药
senses.example: The filaments were long, so the anthers hung far from the petals.
senses.exampleCN: 花丝很长，所以花药离花瓣很远。
senses.why: Because the whole organ was named for its thread, early writers could use the same word for the thread-like stalk, that is the filament, alone.
senses.whyCN: 既然整个器官是以「线」命名的，早期作者就能用同一个词单指其中像线的那段柄，也就是花丝。

senses.title: The warp threads in weaving
senses.definition: the set of straight threads set up on a loom, through which the weaver passes the weft
senses.definitionCN: 织布机上拉直排好的一组线，织工把纬线从中间穿过
senses.example: The singer tightened the stamens across the frame before passing the weft.
senses.exampleCN: 织工先把经线在织框上拉紧，再穿过纬线。
senses.why: Here the thread image returns directly: the upright warp threads of a loom are threads in the original sense.
senses.whyCN: 这里是「线」的形象直接回归：织机上直立的经线，本来就是最原始意义上的线。

intro.en: Stamen is a Latin noun for the warp threads set on a loom, later borrowed by botanists for the thread-like male organ of a flower.
intro.cn: stamen 是拉丁语名词，指织机上的经线，后来被植物学家借去指花中像线一样的雄性器官。

items.en: Stamen means the warp, the upright threads of a loom, and also a thread.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stamen 指经线、织机上的直立的线，也笼统指线。

items.en: Stamen stands beside stamina, warp threads, and stamen and stamina are often used alike for a single thread.
items.cn: stamen 与复数 stamina（经线）并用，两者常混用来指一根线。

items.en: The word enters English for the warp of a loom, keeping the weaving sense.
items.cn: 该词在十六世纪进入英语，先用于织机的经线，保留了织布义。

items.en: Linnaeus and other botanists take stamen for the thread-like male organ of a flower.
items.cn: 十八世纪林奈等植物学家取 stamen 指花中像线的雄性器官。

items.en: Stamen is now mainly a botanical term, while the weaving sense survives only in older texts.
items.cn: 现代英语中 stamen 主要用于植物学，织布义只保留在较早的文本里。

note.en: Stamen sits inside a small botanical family, while its near meanings are the other reproductive parts of a flower.
note.cn: stamen 属于一个小型的植物学词族，近义项则是花的其他生殖器官。

entries.definition: endurance and staying power, originally the plural of stamen

entries.definition: bearing stamens but no pistils
entries.definitionCN: 有雄蕊的；雄性的

entries.definition: the sac at the top of a stamen that holds pollen
entries.definitionCN: 花药；雄蕊顶端盛花粉的囊

entries.definition: the thread-like stalk that carries an anther
entries.definitionCN: 花丝；雄蕊中托着花药的丝状柄

entries.definition: the female part of a flower, where seeds form
entries.definitionCN: 雌蕊；花中形成种子的雌性部分

entries.definition: one of the coloured outer parts of a flower
entries.definitionCN: 花瓣

normalIntro.en: Stamen is a Latin thread: the thin filament of a flower and the warp thread of a loom are the same image.
normalIntro.cn: stamen 是一根拉丁语的线：花中细长的花丝与织机上的经线是同一幅画面。

normal.en: Latin stamen means a warp thread, and the flower part is thread-like.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 stamen 指经线，而花的雄蕊正像一缕线。

normal.en: Stamina is the old plural of stamen, now meaning endurance.
normal.cn: stamina 是 stamen 的旧复数，现在意为耐力。

normal.en: Staminal and staminate are built with -al and -ate.
normal.cn: staminal 与 staminate 分别由 -al、-ate 构成。

normal.en: A stamen holds its pollen in the anther on top of the filament.
normal.cn: 雄蕊把花粉盛在花丝顶端的花药里。

normal.en: Note the spelling: stamen ends in -en, while stamina ends in -ina.
normal.cn: 注意拼写：stamen 以 -en 结尾，stamina 以 -ina 结尾。

abstract.en: Picture a lily with its long stamens dusted orange with pollen.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵百合花，细长的雄蕊上沾满橙色的花粉。

abstract.en: Think of the straight warp threads on a loom waiting for the weft.
abstract.cn: 想象织机上拉直排好的经线等着纬线穿过。

abstract.en: See a bee carrying yellow dust from one flower to the next.
abstract.cn: 想象一只蜜蜂带着黄色花粉从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

examples.en: Each stamen has a thin filament and an anther full of pollen.
examples.cn: 每个雄蕊都由细花丝和装满花粉的花药组成。

examples.en: The lilies had to be trimmed of their stamens before use.
examples.cn: 这些百合花在使用前必须摘掉雄蕊。

examples.en: Stamens in wind-pollinated plants often hang out of the flower.
examples.cn: 靠风传粉的植物，其雄蕊常常垂在花外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「丝特门」——花中专门吐出一丝丝花粉的小门就是雄蕊；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 stamen（经线、线）与复数 stamina（经线）→ 十六世纪进入英语指织机经线 → 十八世纪植物学借指花的雄蕊，核心义「线」，特别是直立的线。

sensesIntro.en: Stamen starts as a Latin warp thread, becomes the thread-like male organ of a flower, is used for the filament alone, and keeps the weaving sense in older texts.
sensesIntro.cn: stamen 从拉丁语的经线出发，变作花中像线的雄性器官，又被单指花丝，而在较早文本里仍保留织布义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a taut upright thread holding something small and loaded at its tip.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根绷直竖立的线，顶端托着一个小而饱满的东西。

branches.en: The whole male organ is named for its thread-like shape.
branches.cn: 整个雄性器官因为形似线而得名。

branches.en: Early botanists could name just the thread, the filament, with the same word.
branches.cn: 早期植物学家可以用同一个词只指那根线，也就是花丝。

branches.en: The original weaving sense of upright threads survives in older texts.
branches.cn: 原本「直立的线」的织布义保留在较早的文本里。

branches.en: Both the full organ and its filament sit at the centre of the open flower.
branches.cn: 完整的雄蕊与其中的花丝都位于盛开的花中心。

branches.en: The filament and the warp thread are both thin, straight, and taut.
branches.cn: 花丝与经线都是细、直、绷紧的线。

intro.en: Stamen comes straight from Latin, and modern English builds its family with -al, -ate, and -less added to the Latin stem.
intro.cn: stamen 直接来自拉丁语，现代英语在拉丁词干上加上 -al、-ate、-less 构成词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin stamen means a warp thread, and its plural stamina first meant the warp threads of a loom.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stamen 意为经线，其复数 stamina 本指织机上的一组经线。

items.exampleCN: stamina 最初是 stamen 的复数。

items.exampleCN: 植物学赋予了 stamen 现代含义。

definition_zh: 耐力；持久力；体力，特指长时间运动后仍能坚持的能力
definition_en: the physical or mental power to keep going for a long time without getting too tired
core_image: 跑到最后一圈还不肯停下的人，胸腔里还有一口气
scene: 参加长跑的最后几百米，双腿发沉，可看台上的人仍在喊加油，选手靠着一股撑到底的力量冲向终点。Even in the last lap, the runner drew on her stamina and pulled ahead of the pack.
sceneCN: 这里 stamina 是「耐力、持久力」（第 1 个义项：长时间坚持所需的体力与心力）；句意：即便到了最后一圈，这名跑者仍靠着耐力超人，甩开了身后的队伍。

derivatives.zh: 耐力的；属雄蕊的
有雄蕊的
雄蕊

senses.title: The power to keep going for a long time
senses.definition: the strength that lets a person or animal keep doing something strenuous for a long period
senses.definitionCN: 使人或动物能长时间从事剧烈活动而不过早疲劳的力量
senses.example: Marathon runners need stamina rather than raw speed.
senses.exampleCN: 马拉松选手需要的是耐力，而不是纯粹的速度。
senses.why: The word comes from Latin stamen, a thread of the warp, and the plural stamina came to mean the threads on which life is spun.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自拉丁语 stamen（织机上的经线），复数 stamina 后来指编织生命之线，于是「经得住拉扯的线」就成了「撑得住的力量」。

senses.title: Mental staying power
senses.definition: the inner capacity to endure effort, boredom, or pressure without giving up
senses.definitionCN: 承受辛苦、枯燥或压力而不放弃的内在能力
senses.example: Reading long legal texts every day takes real mental stamina.
senses.exampleCN: 每天读冗长的法律文本确实需要很强的心理韧性。
senses.why: If bodily stamina is the threads that hold life together, the mental version is the same fibres holding the mind steady through long effort.
senses.whyCN: 身体的耐力是撑住生命的线，照着这个比喻，心力就是用同样的纤维在漫长付出中撑住意志。

senses.title: Endurance in a struggle or task
senses.definition: the ability of an activity, campaign, or person to last through a long period of strain
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动、运动或个人在长期压力下维持下去的能力
senses.example: The volunteers showed remarkable stamina during the flood clean-up.
senses.exampleCN: 在洪水清理行动中，志愿者们展现出惊人的耐久力。
senses.why: Because stamina means strength over time rather than in a single burst, the word extends naturally to campaigns and tasks that test staying power.
senses.whyCN: 耐力强调「持续时间里的力」而非瞬间爆发，所以自然延伸到考验持久性的长线行动与任务。

senses.title: In botany, the stamens of a flower
senses.definition: in older botanical usage, the plural of stamen, the male reproductive organs of a flower
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的植物学用法中作 stamen 的复数，指花的雄性生殖器官
senses.example: Nineteenth-century plant books list the stamens as part of the flower.
senses.exampleCN: 十九世纪的植物学著作把雄蕊列为花的组成部分。
senses.why: This is the literal survival of the Latin plural, preserved in botanical writing long after the everyday word shifted to human strength.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁复数本义的直接留存：日常用法转向人的体力之后，植物学写作仍保留着「雄蕊」这个字面义。

senses.title: The central fibres of a thing
senses.definition: in figurative writing, the essential fibres or framework that give something its strength
senses.definitionCN: 比喻用法中，赋予某事物力量的关键纤维或框架
senses.example: Trust is the stamina of any long partnership.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是任何长久合作关系的核心支撑。
senses.why: The original warp threads are what hold a woven cloth together, so metaphor can still call the binding element of anything its stamina.
senses.whyCN: 最初的经线决定了整块布能否成形，所以比喻里也可以把维系一个事物的关键成分称作它的「主脉」。

intro.en: Stamina began as the Latin plural of stamen, meaning the warp thread of a loom, and came to mean the threads of life before turning into human staying power.
intro.cn: stamina 最初是拉丁语 stamen（织机的经线）的复数，经「生命之线」的比喻，最终演变为人的持久力。

items.en: Stamen is the thread standing upright in the warp of a loom.
items.cn: stamen 指织机经线上竖立的线。

items.en: The Latin plural stamina is also used for the threads of a loom and, by extension, of life.
items.cn: 拉丁复数 stamina 也被用来指织线，并引申为生命的线。

items.en: Pliny uses stamina for the male parts of a flower, the earliest plant sense.
items.cn: 普林尼用 stamina 指花的雄性器官，这是最早的植物学义。

items.en: English takes stamina as a learned plural meaning the vital threads or elemental parts of a body.
items.cn: 英语借入 stamina，作为学者用词，指身体的根本纤维或基本成分。

items.en: Stamina moves from the fibres of life to the power to withstand long effort.
items.cn: stamina 由「生命之纤维」转为「承受长期劳作的力量」。

items.en: Stamina settles into the everyday noun for endurance, and botanists keep the plural sense for stamens.
items.cn: 现代英语中 stamina 固定为「耐力」的日常名词，植物学家则保留其「雄蕊」复数义。

note.en: Stamina belongs with words for staying power, and its closest relatives are the Latin thread words and the endurance vocabulary.
note.cn: stamina 属于「持久力」这一组词，同族词与拉丁语的「线」有关，近义词则集中在耐力与体力。

entries.definition: the ability to suffer something long and difficult without giving up
entries.definitionCN: 忍耐力；指能长时间承受艰苦而不放弃

entries.definition: the ability to keep doing something for a long time
entries.definitionCN: 持久力，口语中与 stamina 很接近

entries.definition: physical or mental energy
entries.definitionCN: 精力；体力，强调活力而未必强调持续时间

normalIntro.en: Stamina is a bundle of threads that hold a person up, and its Latin root stamen still names the thread of a loom.
normalIntro.cn: stamina 是一束把人撑住的线，它的拉丁词根 stamen 至今仍指织机上的经线。

normal.en: Build up stamina by exercising a little longer each week.
normal.cn: 每周把训练时间稍微延长，就能逐步增强耐力。

normal.en: Mental stamina matters in long exams.
normal.cn: 在长时间的考试中，心理韧性很重要。

normal.en: Runners who run out of stamina slow down near the finish.
normal.cn: 体力耗尽的跑者会在临近终点时慢下来。

normal.en: Stamina is an uncountable noun in normal use, so you say more stamina, not more staminas.
normal.cn: stamina 通常是不可数名词，所以要说 more stamina 而不是 more staminas。

normal.en: Compare endurance, which stresses bearing hardship, while stamina stresses lasting physical effort.
normal.cn: 与 endurance 相比，后者强调忍受艰难，stamina 更强调持久的体力付出。

abstract.en: Picture a runner on the final lap with a small flame still burning in the chest.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者在最后一圈时，胸口还燃着一小簇不肯熄灭的火。

abstract.en: Think of the strings of a loom that keep a cloth from unravelling.
abstract.cn: 想想织布机上那些不让布匹散开的经线。

abstract.en: Imagine a long climb where each step depends on the strength of the one before.
abstract.cn: 想象一段漫长的爬坡，每一步都得靠前一步攒下的力气。

examples.en: She lacks the stamina to finish such a long race.
examples.cn: 她没有跑完这么长距离比赛的耐力。

examples.en: Long hours in the lab tested his mental stamina.
examples.cn: 长时间待在实验室里考验了他的心理韧性。

examples.en: Coaches design training so that athletes build up stamina gradually.
examples.cn: 教练设计训练，让运动员逐步增强耐力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「死踏命啊」——咬牙一路踏下去不停步，就是耐力；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 stamen（织机经线；复数 stamina 指经线，也喻指生命的线）→ 拉丁/英语 stamina（生命的纤维）→ 英语 stamina（耐力、持久力）；植物学的「雄蕊」义是该复数形式的字面留存。

sensesIntro.en: Stamina starts with bodily endurance, stretches to inner toughness and to long-lasting effort, then keeps its old botanical plural and a metaphorical fibre sense.
sensesIntro.cn: stamina 由身体的持久力起步，延伸到心理韧性与长线行动中的耐久力，同时保留了植物学的复数本义和「核心纤维」的比喻义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: warp threads that hold a woven cloth together.
core.cn: 核心意象：把一块布撑起来的经线。

branches.en: Physical endurance is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 身体耐力是现代最主要的义项。

branches.en: Inner toughness is the mental branch of the same thread image.
branches.cn: 心理韧性是同一「线」的意象在精神层面的分支。

branches.en: Long-running tasks and campaigns test staying power.
branches.cn: 长线任务与长期行动同样考验持久力。

branches.en: The botanical plural keeps the literal Latin sense of stamens.
branches.cn: 植物学复数保留了拉丁语「雄蕊」的字面义。

branches.en: Metaphor still calls the binding framework of a thing its stamina.
branches.cn: 比喻用法仍把事物的核心支撑称作它的主脉。

intro.en: Stamina is a Latin plural turned English singular, and its relatives cluster around the thread words stamen and staminal rather than around an English prefix.
intro.cn: stamina 是拉丁复数在英语里转成的单数名词，同族词集中在 stamen、staminal 这类「线」与「雄蕊」词上，而不是靠某个英语前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin stamen means the standing warp thread, and its plural stamina was taken over entire, with the -a ending later read as a singular.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stamen 指竖直的经线，其复数 stamina 被整体借入英语，后来词尾 -a 被当作单数来理解。
